newsitem.title: USA: ASARCO creates environmental management team.
newsitem.headline: ASARCO creates environmental management team.

text.p: ASARCO Inc said Friday it had created a special management team to develop a system to bring its mining operation in line with environmental standards.

Donald Walters, general manager of ASARCO's Tennessee Mines Division, Bruce Malone, manager of the Ray unit operations in Arizona, and Clark Otterness, a senior internal consultant at the technical services center in Salt Lake City, will form the team, it said.
ASARCO, based in New York City, is a producer of nonferrous metals, principally copper, lead, zinc, silver and molybdenum with sales of more than $3.0 billion in 1995.
